content.title: Lazydays Narrows Net Loss, Plans Store Divestitures To Refocus Amid Tough Q4
content.summary: Lazydays Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:GORV) shares are trading lower after the company released its fourth-quarter FY24 earnings results on Monday. The company reported a fourth-quarter sales decline of 19.2% year-on-year to $159.88 million from $198.03 million last year. Loss per share of $2.39 narrowed from a $7.59 loss last year.
